note: Both sets capture the same six facts with accurate values, bindings, and supporting quotes: the three first-mode structural damping values (3%, 3%, 6%), the s-coordinate endpoints (0 at suction-side trailing edge, 1 at pressure-side trailing edge), and the flatback trailing-edge definition with its 'for flatback airfoils' condition. The only difference is that Set B preserves the qualifier that the damping values were 'assumed' rather than measured, which is a meaningful provenance condition stated in the source. Set A drops that qualifier, slightly overstating the certainty of the damping values. Neither set contains misread, misbound, or invented claims.
